chapter: Movies and the Los Angeles scene
title: Where he lived in Los Angeles
summary: Besides hotels, he rented a bungalow on 41st Street near Central Avenue while in town.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Now, where did you all live when you worked in Los Angeles?
I mean do you remember which hotels you stayed at?
And, of course, I had my own home out there.
Oh, you had a home out there?
Had you bought it, you know, how did you --
No, it wasn't my own home. I just was renting -- a little bungalow.
Where? In what section of Los Angeles?
Oh, that wasn't far from Central Avenue on 41st Street, I think it was, if I remember correctly.
Now, did you keep, did you keep that place year around or did you just rent it for when you were in town?
Just while I was in town, yeah, "Auto-town" something like living in (inaudible) more or less.
